body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new script, test suite, and generated artifacts to build a deterministic 858-row precise crop source map for figure assets. The code changes are well-structured, but several critical feedback points were raised regarding defensive programming. Specifically, the reviewer identified potential TypeError crashes in packetMembership and countBlockerClasses when dealing with nullish or undefined elements, and suggested refactoring normalizeBlocker to handle nullish inputs more robustly by falling back to an empty object.
